fields.summary: Autonomous plan run for the bug where `rhiza run resume --retry` of ship-change run 01M6XVTXGJAM (PR #393) restarted at ci-triage and failed again on stale state, after a billing outage had failed every CI job with no failing test. The planner found the cause in the code: Engine.Retry reopens at State.FailedStep, and ci-triage (`rhiza ship check --test-failures`) has no on.fail, so an infra-only red head ends the run. The accepted change set 01M6XX4R8 (retry-reopens-at-wait) covers retries of green steps entered from a wait, but not ci-triage, which pr-green's or rebased-green's on.fail reaches. The change set was placed under milestone-25, like the other ship-change fixes. Two questions went to the arbiter. It decided retry-ci-triage-reopens-at-wait: a retry follows the journal back from ci-triage to the check that routed into it and reopens at that check's wait. It also decided ci-triage-infra-waits-for-new-ci: ci-triage's on.fail goes to a new wait step that settles only once CI moved past the judged state, with a 6h timeout and 3 visits, then re-checks at pr-green. The change set depends on 01M6XX4R8, whose engine rule it extends. No owner words: the run was autonomous.
fields.title: Resume-retry at ci-triage plan, autonomous
